messages:
tara: Heads-up — premerge SAST + DAST both tripped on CI. Failures show KMS Decrypt denied when scanner pulls fixtures. CI: https://ci.redwood.example/build/4021 :warning:
mike: saw that. Any recent RBAC or keystore changes?
raj: pushed a key policy tightening at 01:05 UTC to scope usage to specific service principals. Might be related.
tara: log snippet:
```
ERROR: kms.Decrypt failed: AccessDenied: caller not authorized for key
  at keystore.Client.Decrypt (keystore.go:210)
  at scanners.FixtureLoader.Load (fixtures.go:58)
```
mike: quick check: long-lived SAs unaffected; ephemeral tokens used by scanner fail with principalMismatch in KMS audit logs.
raj: confirms — key policy added condition `request.auth.principal =~ "serviceAccount:keystore@redwood.*"` which ephemeral principals don't match.
tara: immediate tasks: preserve CI artifacts & KMS audit, snapshot key policy, get approval for short-lived unblock if needed. I'll take artifacts.
security-bot: evidence ticket SEC-EVID-2026-99 created — bucket link attached.
mike: propose mitigation options: (A) temp policy exception for ephemeral serviceAccount (B) change ephemeral-grants to impersonate keystore SA (C) add CI preflight to validate KMS decrypt before scan step.
raj: (B) is preferred long-term. (A) is faster but must be timeboxed and approved.
tara: can you draft a minimal policy patch with a 4-hour expiry? I'll route approvals.
raj: patch text (conceptual): add member `serviceAccount:ephemeral-grants@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com` to `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter` with `condition` limiting by `request.time < "2026-03-22T06:00:00Z"`.
mike: +1 for timeboxed change; I'll approve once the JSON is posted and an audit-id is generated when applied.
ops-bot: policy-change request received. Requires 2 approvers from {security, platform}.
security-bot: incident SEC-INC-2026-29 created; responders: tara, raj, mike.
raj: applied temp policy at 02:40 UTC (audit-id: g7h8i9). Re-triggering CI.
mike: build 4022 passed — scanners green. https://ci.redwood.example/build/4022 :rocket:
tara: follow-ups: 1) ephemeral-grants PR to add impersonation + unit/integration tests (owner: raj) 2) CI preflight KMS check (owner: mike) 3) add keystore-policy-diff step to deploy checklist (owner: platform team) 4) attach approvals and evidence to postmortem.
raj: opening PR now and will include KMS audit replay test.
security-bot: reminder: postmortem required within 72h; link SEC-EVID-2026-99 attached.
summary: CI SAST/DAST blocked by KMS key-policy condition that excluded ephemeral tokens. Temporary, timeboxed key policy exception applied after approvals; artifacts preserved and incident logged; follow-ups include impersonation for ephemeral-grants and CI preflight checks.
